name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.douyinminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (DouYin Mini Game)
description:
Douyin Mini Game keyboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. Implements IOperationKeyboardManager over TT.ShowKeyboard / TT.HideKeyboard / TT.UpdateKeyboard with the C# events OnKeyboardInput / OnKeyboardConfirm / OnKeyboardComplete, and self-registers into OperationKeyboardRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad via DouYinMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD macros are not enabled — referencing means registering). StarkSDK exposes no keyboard-height API, so OnHeightChanged is an empty implementation by design and Hide unsubscribes every event. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的抖音小游戏键盘适配渠道包。基于 TT.ShowKeyboard / TT.HideKeyboard / TT.UpdateKeyboard 与 C# 事件 OnKeyboardInput / OnKeyboardConfirm / OnKeyboardComplete 实现 IOperationKeyboardManager，由 DouYinMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进 OperationKeyboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪、注册不发生，引用即注册）。StarkSDK 无键盘高度 API，OnHeightChanged 为空实现，Hide 时退订全部事件。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
